counterexamples.evidence: Run 0 served text names "a 7-shaped double threat" and "their own four-in-a-row line" but emits only [zone:future:c6r2] plus the [term:figure_7] tag; the prompt (assembleGroundedPrompt) lists you-future-fork, opp-key-square and you-fork-pivot under "You MUST build the explanation around these", so the referents existed and were offered — the player is shown one square out of three and no line.

The mechanism is a fork (lostResource.tacticTag=figure_7, forkCells=[c2r5], forkCase B). On projectedDeep the pivot c2r4 is the P1 disc at ply 35 and it is what makes c2r5 a <X> gravity-top four; run 0 never names it, though the you-fork-pivot handle is both offered and required in the prompt.

Run 0 attempt1 emitted all three required handles ([zone:you-future-fork]c2r5, [zone:opp-key-square]c6r2, [zone:you-fork-pivot]) but said "the more central column" instead of "column 3", tripping the better-column retry; the retried answer states column 3 and drops two of the three required handles. The retry trigger set is evaluated on attempt1 only, so a retry can silently regress required-handle coverage — model-independent, unlike the prompt_confusion label.
